design_philosophy: A grounded, warm, and highly functional productivity app. Avoids the 'sterile tech' look by using warm undertones, soft shadows, and organic accent colors (terracotta, sage). High-end editorial feel combined with functional dashboard precision.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 for main containers. Embrace negative space.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mode B (Control Room Grid) adapted for mobile-first. grid-cols-1 on mobile, md:grid-cols-2, lg:grid-cols-4. Gaps should be gap-4 to gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Subtle border (1px border-border), flat solid surfaces. Max rounded-md (8px radius) to keep it crisp.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Sticky bottom nav for mobile using Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-t border-border). Top header should also use glassmorphism if content scrolls underneath.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense tracking content and logs. Center-align empty states or success messages.

components.buttons: rounded-md. Primary CTAs use background primary with primary_foreground text. Secondary buttons use border and text_main. Hover states must explicitly set text and bg colors (e.g., hover:bg-primary/90).
components.ai_review_card: Must stand out from normal logs. Use a subtle Glassmorphism background over the ai_review_background media image, with a 'Tracing Beam' or glowing border effect.
components.inputs_and_forms: Use Shadcn customized primitives. 1px border, flat background. Focus states must have ring-2 ring-primary/50.
components.progress_bars: Thick, rounded-full. Use secondary color (Sage) to represent positive habit completion.
components.daily_logger: Bento-style layout for logging. Instead of a standard vertical list, group 'Work', 'Gym', 'Hobbies' into tappable bento blocks.
components.modals_drawers: Use Shadcn Dialog/Drawer. Ensure overlay opacity is bg-black/50 maximum. Use solid background for modal body.

animations_and_motion.page_transition: Use Framer Motion. Fade in and slide up slightly (y: 10).
animations_and_motion.micro_interactions: Scale down slightly on active/tap (active:scale-95) for habit toggle buttons.
animations_and_motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do not rely solely on motion to convey status changes.

icons.usage_rules: Use Duotone or Light weights to match the sophisticated typography. Avoid heavy or filled icons unless indicating an 'active' state.

onboarding_hero.description: Flat lay of coffee, open notebook, pen, and eyeglasses. Warm, mindful aesthetic. Use on login or welcome screens.
onboarding_hero.overlay: Use bg-black/30 overlay if placing text directly over it.

ai_review_background.description: Abstract wavy pattern with pastel colors. Use as a low-opacity background image specifically for the AI Claude Daily Review sections.
ai_review_background.overlay: Must be heavily blurred or opacity-reduced (e.g., opacity-20) behind text to ensure readability.

content_library_placeholder.description: Minimalist bookshelf filled with white books. Use for the content library hero banner or empty state illustration.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use text-shadow when placing text over images.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, toggles, mood selectors, navigation items) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_naming_convention: Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='log-activity-button', data-testid='theme-toggle', data-testid='ai-review-generate').

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: The stack uses React.js and Tailwind CSS with a mobile-app UI paradigm. Use .js/.jsx extensions instead of .tsx.
1. Setup Tailwind CSS with the provided color hexes using CSS variables to support Dark/Light/Auto modes seamlessly.
2. Setup global typography using Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Load these from Google Fonts.
3. Build a mobile-first PWA-style layout: Add a sticky bottom navigation bar (using Glassmorphism) with icons for Home (Log), AI Review, Stats, Library, History.
4. For the Daily Activity Logger, implement a bento grid or compact cards for predefined activities (Work, Gym, Hobbies) and include an 'Add Custom Activity' feature.

5. Integrate Shadcn/UI for complex components (Dialog for custom activities, Progress for weekly stats). Ensure you strip the default Vercel-look to match the specified Organic & Earthy archetype (max 8px border-radius, flat surfaces).
6. Ensure the AI Daily Review (Claude Sonnet 4.5 section) is visually distinct from normal logs by utilizing the 'ai_review_background' image.
7. Implement comprehensive 'data-testid' attributes across all components and interactive elements.
8. DO NOT use generic or placeholder images. Only use the URLs provided in the 'media' section of this JSON.
